claim: Do NOT send STFC a links-page email: the club promoting treestock is a TERM of the site rebuild Benedict is negotiating. Rare Fruit SA is the only live send.

body.stfc_qld: Do NOT send a links-page email. Benedict is mid-negotiation to rebuild stfc.org.au (Sheryl Backhouse) and the club promoting treestock is a TERM of that rebuild, not a favour ask. A separate email during a live proposal undercuts it. DAL-252 holds the committee one-pager, gated on Sheryl asking, and requires a declared conflict of interest (Benedict owns the products the club would link to).
body.rare_fruit_sa: Only live send. Benedict is a member and has offered them the RFCWA photo voting app. Links page confirmed live and maintained (Australian Nurseries section lists Daleys and Perry's Fruit & Nut; already links STFC and RFCWA). Email drafted on DAL-167 and assigned to Benedict: it asks which SA nurseries members buy from rather than requesting a listing, because we have no SA pages to send them to.
body.rare_fruit_australia: Dropped. Site unmaintained, and rfcarchives.org.au is the stronger RFCA-lineage asset we already own.
body.orchard_of_flavours: Dropped. Non-AU domain, topical relevance only.
